selection_rule: maximum input-only velocity first-difference energy among the 30 registered Marmousi validation slices
hypothesis: The input-complexity-maximizing slice will expose more reflected and scattered structure in an eight-source linear-superposition wavefield than the prior rank-15 display.
expected_mechanism: Simultaneous fixed-frequency source illumination excites dipping interfaces and lateral velocity contrasts from several directions; linearity makes the summed single-source fields exactly the corresponding simultaneous-source field.
primary_metric: all-401-frame relative L2 of the summed Phase4b predictions against the summed sealed LWC-84 references
failure_signals: destructive interference removes most heterogeneous scattering from the displayed snapshots
the summed Phase4b error is too large for an interpretable comparison
any source frequency, amplitude, velocity slice, or checkpoint differs across the eight fields
compute_budget: eight sigma=2 LWC-84 background solves and eight update-265 Phase4b inference calls on one idle GPU; no training
rollback: retain the existing rank-15 manuscript figure; do not replace it unless the rank-30 composite is visually clearer and all claims remain case-scoped
truth_access_rule: seal all eight predictions before opening the existing sealed references
claim_scope: input-selected one-slice position-only visualization; not a population accuracy or frequency-generalization result

outcome.decision: The complex structures remain visible after physical superposition, so the figure is accepted as qualitative complex-medium evidence. It does not replace the 4.51% G3 accuracy result.
